notes.title: Update 0.01.08 is ready! ~~ Space Pirates ~~
notes.notes:
New Features:
- Space pirates will randomly spawn and attack you, your ships, and each other! (*They will not spawn in creative mode and arena mode.)
- Old game files can now be deleted from the load menu.
- Unwanted custom ships can also be deleted from the ship-spawn menu.

Bug Fixes:
- NPCs will unspawn when their ship is destroyed.
- Minor network bug fixes.

Graphical Fixes:
- Star patterns should match up for all players.

Let us know if you encounter any issues while playing and as always feedback and suggestions are appreciated! Leave them in the community hub or in our discord: https://discord.gg/td9s6D2

notes.title: Network Update 0.01.05 is now live for PC and Mac!
notes.notes:
At last Starbucket has been updated to support online games with your Steam friends! Join your friends' games directly or play with others on Steam now!

ALSO Starbucket is now available for Mac!

Please visit our Discord with any questions or issues. We also appreciate feedback! https://discord.gg/td9s6D2

notes.title: Minor Patch Update 0.01.04
notes.notes:
Fixed some minor bugs today!
- Respawning on a destroyed ship in arena mode is resolved.
- Capped explosion sounds for large ships (they were far too loud).
- Minor graphical fixes as well.
